source: Original HTML served from an external temporary directory; shared images and vendor resources were verified unchanged before linking.
network: Only http://127.0.0.1:18765 allowed. External fonts, analytics and legacy localhost requests blocked equally for old/new versions. Emoji Worker disabled to avoid unrelated generated worker/network activity.
limitations: External web fonts are not covered; comparisons use the same fallback fonts.
Chromium and fixed viewport coverage is not proof of cross-browser or physical-device equivalence.
Animations are disabled for screenshots; their timing is not certified by pixel comparison.
Existing duplicate script declarations and old vendor dependencies are retained in this first refactor.
